description: Unified shared base for both lines (line parity, coordinator decision 2026-10-12 following Pop's main LFM line, decision pop-2356): neuralese-direct-v2 on the admitted target union natlang-target-union-20261011-r2 (training/corpus-manifests/natlang-target-union-20261011-r2.json) with three phases of one lineage: direct_warmup, 0.5 epoch of the full-prompt rendering; direct_sft, 1 epoch of the program-header rendering (owner decision 2026-10-12: one epoch, not two) (~133k train documents), continuing from the warm-up; direct_trajectory, 1 epoch of the whole-trajectory rendering (~76k documents), continuing from direct_sft. Each later phase continues from its predecessor phase's full state with the lineage's identity check and the base drift reference (recipe.py DIRECT_PHASE_CONTINUATION). The base binds the LFM2.5 renders; a line with another tokenizer binds the same union's twin renders (same document ids, splits and source groups). Everything else is neuralese-direct-v2.
